notes.title: Visual Novel Fest :3
notes.notes:
Exciting news! Deperson is part of Steam Visual Novel Fest, running from March 2-10! 🎉

This is a great chance to explore story-driven games like ours, where choices shape the narrative and uncover deep mysteries. If you haven’t yet, now’s the perfect time to wishlist and try the demo!

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025
notes.notes:
Deperson has been selected for Tokyo Indie Games Summit 2025, taking place between March 1st and 13th! 🏮✨ But that’s not all—we’ll also be attending in person at the summit on March 8-9 in Tokyo! If you're around, we'd love to meet you face-to-face!

We're incredibly honored to be one of the featured games at the event and can’t wait to share more about Deperson with the global indie game community. This is a huge opportunity for us, and we’re excited to connect with players, fellow developers, and publishers.

If you're attending, come say hi and chat with us about the game! 🖤

🔹 Event Dates: March 1-13, 2025
🔹 In-Person Meetup: March 8-9 in Tokyo

Thank you for all your support—we wouldn’t be here without you! See you in Tokyo! 🇯🇵🎮

notes.title: Deperson Webtoon is Out!
notes.notes:
The story takes place 5-10 years before the game, when our characters were still in high school :3
You can read it for free by searching for Deperson on Webtoon :3 
We'll release a new chapter every month!!
 We hope you'll enjoy it!!!

[u]Plot[/u]

Aaron’s life is a constant battle between reality and the dark secrets. As others reveal unsettling sides, Aaron’s mind begins to fracture, and the line between what’s real and imagined blurs. 

The deeper he digs, the darker the mysteries grow. One wrong move could plunge him into madness forever. 

This webtoon explores Aaron’s journey through a world where understanding the past may be the only way to survive the future.

notes.title: Demo Fixes & Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We hope you’re all doing well. We’ve got some exciting news to share!

We’ve addressed all your feedback and made significant improvements to the gameplay of our demo :3
[i]It’s now easier, more player-friendly, and feels fresher than ever![/i]

[list]
[*] The "F" spam is much, much easier now—we’ve fixed it! No more gameover streaks at the start of the game o7
[*] We’ve created new sounds for when our characters glitch and also adjusted the sounds that were too loud or uncomfortable ://
[*] New animations have been added! Now Cloud and Sophia can dash too. ;) Good for them...
[*] We’ve squashed some bugs and enhanced the overall experience. We’ve also made optimizations for you and your PCs.
[*] We noticed that many players tried to solve the platform puzzle by having all the characters stand on it, so we thought, why not? Now that’s a valid solution! You all are really creative and clever :3
[*] The garden scene (some call it the elevator part) is much easier now. For those who couldn’t solve it, we’ve rearranged the characters’ positions. Plus, with the new dash mechanics, it’s much more doable.
[*] Oh, and you can now skip dialogues! Just press F a little longer, and voilà—magic happens! Uuu~
[/list]

We love you :3 Also, sorry for the late update—there are only three of us…
Take care!

[b]Error Thing[/b]
